description: ALTER TABLE ADD/DROP constraint commands through DESCRIBE's primary key/unique key cells and the SHOW KEYS listings: plain, composite and named PRIMARY KEY/UNIQUE/FOREIGN KEY additions, composite FKs listing one row per key column with key_sequence, DROP CONSTRAINT, qualified names, IF EXISTS, mixed operations - and the referential-action rule: any action other than NO ACTION silently drops the whole foreign key (CASCADE, SET NULL, RESTRICT, on delete/update/both) while NO ACTION is kept with its rules. Converted 1:1 from features/AlterTableConstraintsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR, email VARCHAR)
ALTER TABLE users ADD PRIMARY KEY (id)
DESCRIBE TABLE users
SELECT MAX(IFF("name" = 'ID', "primary key", NULL)), MAX(IFF("name" = 'NAME', "primary key", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))

DESCRIBE TABLE order_items
